package domain

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"strings"
	"time"
	"unicode/utf8"
)

const (
	SubjectDialogTeacherRequested         = "dialog.teacher.requested"
	DialogTeacherRequestedSchemaVersionV1 = 1
	DialogTeacherRequestedSchemaVersionV2 = 2
	DialogTeacherRequestedSchemaVersion   = DialogTeacherRequestedSchemaVersionV2
)

var (
	ErrInvalidDialogContext   = errors.New("invalid dialog context")
	ErrDialogRequestNotFound  = errors.New("dialog request not found")
	ErrDialogStateUnavailable = errors.New("dialog state unavailable")
)

// TeacherDialogBinding is the canonical Dialog-owned conversation binding
// returned to the authenticated student. Teacher-agent owns neither messages
// nor the dialog lifecycle; it only provisions the binding through Dialog.
type TeacherDialogBinding struct {
	ID                string              `json:"id"`
	StudentID         string              `json:"student_id"`
	PersonalTeacherID string              `json:"personal_teacher_id"`
	ContextType       LearningContextType `json:"context_type"`
	ContextID         string              `json:"context_id,omitempty"`
	Created           bool                `json:"created"`
}

func NewTeacherDialogBinding(input TeacherDialogBinding) (TeacherDialogBinding, error) {
	input.ID = strings.TrimSpace(input.ID)
	input.StudentID = strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentID)
	input.PersonalTeacherID = strings.TrimSpace(input.PersonalTeacherID)
	input.ContextID = strings.TrimSpace(input.ContextID)
	if !validUUID(input.ID) || !validUUID(input.StudentID) || !validUUID(input.PersonalTeacherID) ||
		!validTeacherDialogBindingContext(input.ContextType, input.ContextID) {
		return TeacherDialogBinding{}, ErrInvalidDialogContext
	}
	return input, nil
}

func validTeacherDialogBindingContext(contextType LearningContextType, contextID string) bool {
	if !validContextType(contextType) {
		return false
	}
	if contextType == LearningContextGeneral {
		return contextID == ""
	}
	return validUUID(contextID)
}

type DialogTeacherRequest struct {
	SchemaVersion       int
	EventID             string
	DialogID            string
	EventSequence       int64
	TeacherTurnSequence int64
	SourceMessageID     string
	SourceSequence      int64
	// SourceMessageVersion and ReplyToMessageID are emitted by Dialog v2. They
	// remain optional while old v2 events drain; the S5 coordinator requires
	// both values before it considers a user turn eligible for onboarding.
	SourceMessageVersion      int64
	ReplyToMessageID          string
	CanonicalStudentMessageID string
	CorrelationID             string
	// DialogCausationID is the causation identity emitted by Dialog. It is
	// intentionally distinct from CausationID, which is derived for the
	// Teacher-job boundary and equals EventID.
	DialogCausationID string
	CausationID       string
	ActionReceiptID   string
	StudentCommandID  string
	SourceChannel     DialogMessageChannel
	StudentID         string
	PersonalTeacherID string
	ContextType       LearningContextType
	ContextID         string
	LearningActionID  string
	OccurredAt        time.Time
}

func NewDialogTeacherRequest(input DialogTeacherRequest) (DialogTeacherRequest, error) {
	if input.SchemaVersion == 0 {
		input.SchemaVersion = DialogTeacherRequestedSchemaVersionV1
	}
	input.EventID = strings.TrimSpace(input.EventID)
	input.DialogID = strings.TrimSpace(input.DialogID)
	input.SourceMessageID = strings.TrimSpace(input.SourceMessageID)
	input.ReplyToMessageID = strings.TrimSpace(input.ReplyToMessageID)
	input.StudentID = strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentID)
	input.PersonalTeacherID = strings.TrimSpace(input.PersonalTeacherID)
	input.ContextID = strings.TrimSpace(input.ContextID)
	input.LearningActionID = strings.TrimSpace(input.LearningActionID)
	input.CanonicalStudentMessageID = strings.TrimSpace(input.CanonicalStudentMessageID)
	input.CorrelationID = strings.TrimSpace(input.CorrelationID)
	input.DialogCausationID = strings.TrimSpace(input.DialogCausationID)
	input.CausationID = strings.TrimSpace(input.CausationID)
	input.ActionReceiptID = strings.TrimSpace(input.ActionReceiptID)
	input.StudentCommandID = strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentCommandID)
	input.SourceChannel = normalizeDialogMessageChannel(input.SourceChannel)
	// PostgreSQL stores timestamptz at microsecond precision. Normalize before
	// durable intake so an identical JetStream redelivery cannot look different
	// after the first value has made a database round trip.
	input.OccurredAt = input.OccurredAt.UTC().Truncate(time.Microsecond)
	if (input.SchemaVersion != DialogTeacherRequestedSchemaVersionV1 && input.SchemaVersion != DialogTeacherRequestedSchemaVersionV2) ||
		!validUUID(input.EventID) || !validUUID(input.DialogID) || !validUUID(input.SourceMessageID) ||
		!validUUID(input.StudentID) || !validUUID(input.PersonalTeacherID) || input.EventSequence < 1 ||
		input.SourceSequence < 1 || !input.SourceChannel.valid() || input.OccurredAt.IsZero() || !validContextType(input.ContextType) {
		return DialogTeacherRequest{}, ErrInvalidDialogContext
	}
	if !validDialogContextShape(input.ContextType, input.ContextID, input.LearningActionID) {
		return DialogTeacherRequest{}, ErrInvalidDialogContext
	}
	if input.SourceMessageVersion < 0 || (input.ReplyToMessageID != "" && !validUUID(input.ReplyToMessageID)) {
		return DialogTeacherRequest{}, ErrInvalidDialogContext
	}
	if input.SchemaVersion == DialogTeacherRequestedSchemaVersionV2 {
		// Dialog v2 carries only canonical message/action evidence.  The
		// Student command is Teacher-owned: S5 obtains the frozen deterministic
		// command ID from the local action receipt (or allocates/persists it for
		// text) after durable job admission.  Accepting it from the public Dialog
		// event would make that identity forgeable and would break action replay.
		if input.StudentCommandID != "" {
			return DialogTeacherRequest{}, ErrInvalidDialogContext
		}
		// Dialog's event causation is the canonical Student message. The
		// Teacher-job causation is a separate boundary field derived from the
		// stable source event ID; Dialog must not be made to emit that value.
		if !validUUID(input.DialogCausationID) || input.DialogCausationID != input.CanonicalStudentMessageID {
			return DialogTeacherRequest{}, ErrInvalidDialogContext
		}
		correlation, correlationErr := NormalizeTeacherJobTurnCorrelation(TeacherJobTurnCorrelation{
			SourceEventID: input.EventID, TeacherTurnSequence: input.TeacherTurnSequence,
			DialogID: input.DialogID, CanonicalStudentMessageID: input.CanonicalStudentMessageID,
			SourceMessageSequence: input.SourceSequence, StudentID: input.StudentID,
			PersonalTeacherID: input.PersonalTeacherID, ActionReceiptID: input.ActionReceiptID,
			CorrelationID: input.CorrelationID,
			CausationID:   input.EventID,
		})
		if correlationErr != nil {
			return DialogTeacherRequest{}, ErrInvalidDialogContext
		}
		input.CanonicalStudentMessageID = correlation.CanonicalStudentMessageID
		input.CorrelationID = correlation.CorrelationID
		input.CausationID = correlation.CausationID
		input.ActionReceiptID = correlation.ActionReceiptID
		input.StudentCommandID = ""
	}
	return input, nil
}

// HasFrozenOnboardingReplyMetadata distinguishes new Dialog v2 events from
// accepted legacy events.  It is intentionally an eligibility predicate, not
// a decoder requirement: an old v2 delivery must remain a legacy chat turn.
func (request DialogTeacherRequest) HasFrozenOnboardingReplyMetadata() bool {
	return request.SourceMessageVersion > 0 && validUUID(request.ReplyToMessageID)
}

func (request DialogTeacherRequest) UsesDenseTeacherOrdering() bool {
	return request.SchemaVersion == DialogTeacherRequestedSchemaVersionV2
}

func validDialogContextShape(contextType LearningContextType, contextID, learningActionID string) bool {
	if !validContextType(contextType) {
		return false
	}
	if contextType == LearningContextGeneral {
		return contextID == "" && learningActionID == ""
	}
	if !validUUID(contextID) {
		return false
	}
	if requiresLearningAction(contextType) {
		return validUUID(learningActionID)
	}
	return learningActionID == ""
}

type DialogMessageAuthorType string

const (
	DialogMessageAuthorUser            DialogMessageAuthorType = "user"
	DialogMessageAuthorPersonalTeacher DialogMessageAuthorType = "personal_teacher"
)

type DialogMessageChannel string

const (
	DialogMessageChannelWeb      DialogMessageChannel = "web"
	DialogMessageChannelTelegram DialogMessageChannel = "telegram"
)

func (channel DialogMessageChannel) valid() bool {
	return channel == DialogMessageChannelWeb || channel == DialogMessageChannelTelegram
}

func normalizeDialogMessageChannel(channel DialogMessageChannel) DialogMessageChannel {
	channel = DialogMessageChannel(strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(string(channel))))
	if channel == "" {
		return DialogMessageChannelWeb
	}
	return channel
}

type DialogMessage struct {
	ID                string
	DialogID          string
	AuthorType        DialogMessageAuthorType
	Channel           DialogMessageChannel
	SenderID          string
	PersonalTeacherID string
	LearningActionID  string
	LessonContext     *LessonMessageContext
	AssistantUI       json.RawMessage
	ReplyToMessageID  string
	Body              string
	Status            int
	Version           int
	MessageSequence   int64
	LastEventSequence int64
	CreatedAt         time.Time
}

func NewDialogTeacherStructuredProactive(binding TeacherDialogBinding, message DialogMessage, body string, assistantUI json.RawMessage) (DialogMessage, error) {
	normalized, err := NewDialogTeacherProactive(binding, message)
	if err != nil || normalized.Version < 1 || !ValidOnboardingFallback(body) || normalized.Body != body {
		return DialogMessage{}, ErrInvalidDialogContext
	}
	if !equivalentStrictAssistantUI(assistantUI, normalized.AssistantUI) {
		return DialogMessage{}, ErrInvalidDialogContext
	}
	return normalized, nil
}

type DialogRequestContext struct {
	DialogID          string
	StudentID         string
	PersonalTeacherID string
	ContextType       LearningContextType
	ContextID         string
	SourceMessageID   string
	LearningActionID  string
	Messages          []DialogMessage
}

func NewDialogRequestContext(input DialogRequestContext) (DialogRequestContext, error) {
	input.DialogID = strings.TrimSpace(input.DialogID)
	input.StudentID = strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentID)
	input.PersonalTeacherID = strings.TrimSpace(input.PersonalTeacherID)
	input.ContextID = strings.TrimSpace(input.ContextID)
	input.SourceMessageID = strings.TrimSpace(input.SourceMessageID)
	input.LearningActionID = strings.TrimSpace(input.LearningActionID)
	if !validUUID(input.DialogID) || !validUUID(input.StudentID) || !validUUID(input.PersonalTeacherID) ||
		!validUUID(input.SourceMessageID) || len(input.Messages) < 1 || len(input.Messages) > 50 {
		return DialogRequestContext{}, ErrInvalidDialogContext
	}
	if !validDialogContextShape(input.ContextType, input.ContextID, input.LearningActionID) {
		return DialogRequestContext{}, ErrInvalidDialogContext
	}
	previousSequence := int64(0)
	normalized := make([]DialogMessage, len(input.Messages))
	for index, message := range input.Messages {
		message.ID = strings.TrimSpace(message.ID)
		message.DialogID = strings.TrimSpace(message.DialogID)
		message.SenderID = strings.TrimSpace(message.SenderID)
		message.PersonalTeacherID = strings.TrimSpace(message.PersonalTeacherID)
		message.LearningActionID = strings.TrimSpace(message.LearningActionID)
		message.ReplyToMessageID = strings.TrimSpace(message.ReplyToMessageID)
		message.Channel = normalizeDialogMessageChannel(message.Channel)
		message.CreatedAt = message.CreatedAt.UTC()
		if !validUUID(message.ID) || message.DialogID != input.DialogID || message.MessageSequence <= previousSequence ||
			!message.Channel.valid() || message.LastEventSequence < message.MessageSequence || message.CreatedAt.IsZero() || (message.Status != 1 && message.Status != 2) {
			return DialogRequestContext{}, ErrInvalidDialogContext
		}
		switch message.AuthorType {
		case DialogMessageAuthorUser:
			if message.SenderID != input.StudentID || message.PersonalTeacherID != "" {
				return DialogRequestContext{}, ErrInvalidDialogContext
			}
		case DialogMessageAuthorPersonalTeacher:
			if message.SenderID != "" || message.PersonalTeacherID != input.PersonalTeacherID {
				return DialogRequestContext{}, ErrInvalidDialogContext
			}
		default:
			return DialogRequestContext{}, ErrInvalidDialogContext
		}
		if requiresLearningAction(input.ContextType) && !validUUID(message.LearningActionID) {
			return DialogRequestContext{}, ErrInvalidDialogContext
		}
		if !requiresLearningAction(input.ContextType) && message.LearningActionID != "" {
			return DialogRequestContext{}, ErrInvalidDialogContext
		}
		lessonContext, lessonErr := NormalizeLessonMessageContext(message.LessonContext)
		if input.ContextType == LearningContextLesson {
			if message.LessonContext != nil && lessonErr != nil {
				return DialogRequestContext{}, ErrInvalidDialogContext
			}
			if lessonContext != nil && lessonContext.Schema == LessonMessageContextSchemaVersion &&
				lessonContext.LessonID != input.ContextID {
				return DialogRequestContext{}, ErrInvalidDialogContext
			}
			if message.AuthorType == DialogMessageAuthorUser && message.Status == 2 && message.LessonContext != nil {
				return DialogRequestContext{}, ErrInvalidDialogContext
			}
			if message.AuthorType == DialogMessageAuthorPersonalTeacher && message.LessonContext != nil {
				return DialogRequestContext{}, ErrInvalidDialogContext
			}
		} else if message.LessonContext != nil {
			return DialogRequestContext{}, ErrInvalidDialogContext
		}
		message.LessonContext = lessonContext
		if message.ReplyToMessageID != "" && !validUUID(message.ReplyToMessageID) {
			return DialogRequestContext{}, ErrInvalidDialogContext
		}
		previousSequence = message.MessageSequence
		normalized[index] = message
	}
	source := normalized[len(normalized)-1]
	if source.ID != input.SourceMessageID || source.AuthorType != DialogMessageAuthorUser ||
		source.SenderID != input.StudentID || source.Status != 1 || source.LearningActionID != input.LearningActionID ||
		strings.TrimSpace(source.Body) == "" || (input.ContextType == LearningContextLesson && source.LessonContext == nil) {
		return DialogRequestContext{}, ErrInvalidDialogContext
	}
	if input.ContextType == LearningContextLesson {
		currentLessonContext, err := NormalizeCurrentLessonMessageContext(source.LessonContext)
		if err != nil || currentLessonContext.LessonID != input.ContextID {
			return DialogRequestContext{}, ErrInvalidDialogContext
		}
		normalized[len(normalized)-1].LessonContext = currentLessonContext
	}
	input.Messages = normalized
	return input, nil
}

func NewDialogTeacherResponse(request DialogTeacherRequest, message DialogMessage) (DialogMessage, error) {
	normalizedRequest, err := NewDialogTeacherRequest(request)
	if err != nil {
		return DialogMessage{}, err
	}
	message.ID = strings.TrimSpace(message.ID)
	message.DialogID = strings.TrimSpace(message.DialogID)
	message.SenderID = strings.TrimSpace(message.SenderID)
	message.PersonalTeacherID = strings.TrimSpace(message.PersonalTeacherID)
	message.LearningActionID = strings.TrimSpace(message.LearningActionID)
	message.ReplyToMessageID = strings.TrimSpace(message.ReplyToMessageID)
	message.Channel = normalizeDialogMessageChannel(message.Channel)
	message.CreatedAt = message.CreatedAt.UTC()
	if !validUUID(message.ID) || message.DialogID != normalizedRequest.DialogID ||
		message.AuthorType != DialogMessageAuthorPersonalTeacher || message.Channel != normalizedRequest.SourceChannel || message.SenderID != "" ||
		message.PersonalTeacherID != normalizedRequest.PersonalTeacherID ||
		message.LessonContext != nil ||
		message.LearningActionID != normalizedRequest.LearningActionID ||
		message.ReplyToMessageID != normalizedRequest.SourceMessageID || message.Status != 1 ||
		message.MessageSequence < 1 || message.LastEventSequence < message.MessageSequence ||
		message.CreatedAt.IsZero() || strings.TrimSpace(message.Body) == "" ||
		!utf8.ValidString(message.Body) || utf8.RuneCountInString(message.Body) > 100000 {
		return DialogMessage{}, ErrInvalidDialogContext
	}
	return message, nil
}

func NewDialogTeacherProactive(binding TeacherDialogBinding, message DialogMessage) (DialogMessage, error) {
	normalizedBinding, err := NewTeacherDialogBinding(binding)
	if err != nil || normalizedBinding.ContextType != LearningContextGeneral {
		return DialogMessage{}, ErrInvalidDialogContext
	}
	message.ID = strings.TrimSpace(message.ID)
	message.DialogID = strings.TrimSpace(message.DialogID)
	message.SenderID = strings.TrimSpace(message.SenderID)
	message.PersonalTeacherID = strings.TrimSpace(message.PersonalTeacherID)
	message.LearningActionID = strings.TrimSpace(message.LearningActionID)
	message.ReplyToMessageID = strings.TrimSpace(message.ReplyToMessageID)
	message.Channel = normalizeDialogMessageChannel(message.Channel)
	message.CreatedAt = message.CreatedAt.UTC()
	if !validUUID(message.ID) || message.DialogID != normalizedBinding.ID ||
		message.AuthorType != DialogMessageAuthorPersonalTeacher || message.Channel != DialogMessageChannelWeb || message.SenderID != "" ||
		message.PersonalTeacherID != normalizedBinding.PersonalTeacherID || message.LearningActionID != "" ||
		message.LessonContext != nil || message.ReplyToMessageID != "" || message.Status != 1 ||
		message.MessageSequence < 1 || message.LastEventSequence < message.MessageSequence ||
		message.CreatedAt.IsZero() || strings.TrimSpace(message.Body) == "" ||
		!utf8.ValidString(message.Body) || utf8.RuneCountInString(message.Body) > 100000 {
		return DialogMessage{}, ErrInvalidDialogContext
	}
	return message, nil
}

func NewDialogStudentChannelMessage(binding TeacherDialogBinding, message DialogMessage) (DialogMessage, error) {
	normalizedBinding, err := NewTeacherDialogBinding(binding)
	if err != nil || normalizedBinding.ContextType != LearningContextGeneral {
		return DialogMessage{}, ErrInvalidDialogContext
	}
	message.ID = strings.TrimSpace(message.ID)
	message.DialogID = strings.TrimSpace(message.DialogID)
	message.SenderID = strings.TrimSpace(message.SenderID)
	message.PersonalTeacherID = strings.TrimSpace(message.PersonalTeacherID)
	message.LearningActionID = strings.TrimSpace(message.LearningActionID)
	message.ReplyToMessageID = strings.TrimSpace(message.ReplyToMessageID)
	message.Channel = normalizeDialogMessageChannel(message.Channel)
	message.CreatedAt = message.CreatedAt.UTC()
	if !validUUID(message.ID) || message.DialogID != normalizedBinding.ID ||
		message.AuthorType != DialogMessageAuthorUser || message.Channel != DialogMessageChannelTelegram ||
		message.SenderID != normalizedBinding.StudentID || message.PersonalTeacherID != "" ||
		message.LearningActionID != "" || message.LessonContext != nil || message.ReplyToMessageID != "" ||
		message.Status != 1 || message.MessageSequence < 1 || message.LastEventSequence < message.MessageSequence ||
		message.CreatedAt.IsZero() || strings.TrimSpace(message.Body) == "" ||
		!utf8.ValidString(message.Body) || utf8.RuneCountInString(message.Body) > 100000 {
		return DialogMessage{}, ErrInvalidDialogContext
	}
	return message, nil
}
